factual_summaries.summary: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains added enterprise managed settings covering plugin governance, MCP server allow/deny lists, managed OpenTelemetry configuration, and organization-controlled permission modes that can disable Bypass Approvals or Autopilot.
GitHub added token-type-specific bulk deauthorization and revocation for enterprises and organizations, with audit-log capture and affected-user notifications.

ShepHertz launched AgentAnywhere, a sovereign agentic AI platform for regulated sectors that runs agents inside customer-controlled infrastructure or cloud environments, uses customer encryption keys, and includes data masking, prompt-injection screening, central model/tool/agent communication governance, and signed evidence packs.

The article argues that static annual audits do not fit agents whose prompts, memory, models, and tool access change continuously; it frames live agent inventory, scoped permissions, accountability trails, monitoring, enforcement, and proof as prerequisites for governance.
